items.heading: Every "Top Skills" List
items.text: Every "top skills" list in India right now says roughly the same eight or nine names. That is not wrong, it is just incomplete. The real story is inside each name.

items.heading: Here Is the Current Picture,
items.text: Here is the current picture, category by category, based on demand signals and salary data rather than a single opinion piece. Read the rank as "how strong is the current market signal," not as "how much should this matter to you personally", that second question depends on your own fit, which the review point framework further down helps you answer.
